title: Living and Non-Living Things
seo_title: Grade 1 Science: Living and Non-Living Things Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Identify living and non-living things; describe the characteristics of living things and how plants and animals, including humans, are alike and different. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand B: Life Systems – Needs and Characteristics of Living Things)
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 science worksheets on living and non-living things and the parts of plants and animals, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: They need food, water and air. Rocks and toys do not.
body_html:
How to think about it

Living things grow, change and need food, water and air.

  • Plants and animals are living.
  • Rocks, toys and water are not living.
  • Living things make babies or seeds.
Example

Is a tree living?

It grows.

It needs water.

Answer: yes

Example

Is a rock living?

It does not grow.

Answer: no

Common mistakes

  • Thinking things that move, like cars, are living.
  • Thinking plants are not living because they do not walk.

faq.q: How do we know something is living?
faq.a: It grows, changes, needs food, water and air, and can make more of its own kind.
Yes. People grow, eat, breathe and have babies, just like other animals.
